scope: P1 provenance verification; canonical promotion intentionally deferred.

acquisition.evidence: The maintained all-186 PQ guide lists Counter Burst under PQ75 Basic Reward.

mechanics.summary: User raises a barrier; when struck by a Ki Blast skill, a counter Ki projectile is fired and knocks the opponent away.
mechanics.reviewed_numeric_context: The reviewed Xenoverse 2 skill reference reports approximately 20% damage over 6 hits; this remains contextual evidence and is not promoted as universal canonical damage data.

availability.future_warrior: Documented as obtainable by the Future Warrior in Xenoverse 2.
availability.partner_customization: Counter Burst is also documented in Vegeta partner customization after the relevant update; this is recorded as an alternate endpoint, not substituted for the PQ acquisition route.

guardrails: Do not infer drop probability from community reports.
Do not promote the contextual 20% figure to a universal canonical damage field.
Do not add an Ultimate Finish requirement when the reward is explicitly listed as a Basic Reward.
Do not mutate oversized canonical skills catalogs without the supported builder/runtime.
